finalText:
Build now completes cleanly (exit 0). The screen of warnings was almost entirely harmless deprecation noise from the dependency bump (unchanged `Buffer()`, `fs.exists`, punycode, etc.), but buried in it were two real breakages caused by shape changes in the new bundler version:

- `resolveRetries` was still reading `options.retries` instead of the new `options.retryCount`, so it crashed on `undefined.toFixed()`.
- `isBackoffEnabled` only accepted explicit `true`/`false`, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined`, so it threw instead of defaulting to disabled.

Fixed both call sites; the link stage now succeeds and the build finishes with 8 (cosmetic) deprecation warnings, 0 errors.
